## Summary of Changes

A concise explanation of what this Pull Request introduces, changes, or fixes.

## Motivation & Context

Why is this change required? What problem does it solve?
Closes #(issue number if applicable)

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding a rule or functionality)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (no functional code changes)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor or code cleanup
- [ ] 🧪 Test suite additions or enhancements

## Pre-submission Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's standards and formatting.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass cleanly (`pytest -v`).
- [ ] Self-verification passes with 0 findings (`python -m corral_lite.cli check src/corral_lite`).
- [ ] I have updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` where applicable.
